title: “parents who cause harm”: a study of the attachment theory in christopher durang’s ‘the marriage of bette and boo’
core_idea: Apply Bowlby’s attachment theory to examine toxic parental behaviors in Christopher Durang’s The Marriage of Bette and Boo and to explore how early parent–child relationships form insecure attachment patterns that influence later relationships with partners and children.
tldr: Psychological analysis using attachment theory to analyze types of toxic parenting (dysfunctional, harmful, psychologically damaging) and the associated insecure attachment patterns (avoidant, ambivalent, disorganized) in the play’s characters, and to explore implications for children's future relationships.
